input_oneliner: 46M IVDU w/ PICC for vertebral osteo, day 10 vanc, T 38.9 with rigors tonight, no localizing sx per RN

optional_context.comorbidity: injection drug use, vertebral osteomyelitis, PICC line

reference_targets_freetext.item: Inspect and palpate the PICC insertion site and tract for erythema, tenderness, purulence, and a palpable cord along the vein
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Exit-site findings are specific but insensitive for line infection; rigors during or after infusion strengthen the diagnosis

reference_targets_freetext.item: Cardiac auscultation for a new or changed murmur, plus peripheral stigmata: splinter hemorrhages, Janeway lesions, Osler nodes, conjunctival petechiae
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: IVDU with bacteremia risk is a high pretest population for endocarditis; a new regurgitant murmur is a major criterion

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about stool frequency and consistency; examine the abdomen for distension and tenderness
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Antibiotic exposure makes C. difficile a leading nosocomial cause of fever; abdominal findings signal severity

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask: timing of rigors relative to infusions or line access; any new injection since admission; new medications
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Infusion-related rigors point to the line; in-hospital injection raises new bacteremia risk

reference_targets_freetext.item: Skin exam for a new maculopapular rash and check for new joint pain
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Vancomycin-associated drug fever and DRESS present with rash and eosinophilia

reference_targets_freetext.item: Spinal percussion tenderness and focused neurologic exam of the legs
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Progression of vertebral osteomyelitis or epidural abscess can present as recurrent fever

off_bedside_acceptable: MRI spine if new neurologic signs
should_not_recommend: Echocardiogram ordered before cardiac auscultation and line-site inspection
Empiric antibiotic change before examining the line site and obtaining paired cultures
